agents.name: Enrique Esparza
agents.bioHtml:
With over 13 years of experience and over 100 closed transactions, I’ve built my real estate business on two principles: integrity first, results always. For me, real estate is about more than buying and selling properties. It’s about building lasting relationships, earning trust, and helping people make confident decisions about their future.

As a bilingual professional fluent in English and Spanish, I enjoy working with first-time homebuyers, sellers, investors, and homeowners navigating short sales and foreclosures. My clients know they can count on me for honest advice, responsive communication, and in-depth knowledge of the Southern California real estate market. I take pride in going the extra mile to make every transaction as smooth and stress-free as possible.

Whether you're buying your first home, selling a property, or exploring investment opportunities, I’m committed to understanding your goals and helping you achieve them. I proudly serve clients throughout Southern California, bringing local market expertise, personalized guidance, and a commitment to getting results. More than 77% of my business comes from referrals, which I consider one of the greatest compliments I can receive. The trust my clients place in me is something I work hard to earn with every transaction.

Whether you're ready to make a move or just exploring your options, I’m always happy to talk and help you plan your next step.
